SELECT
  CAST(strftime("Thời gian", '%Y%m%d') AS VARCHAR) || '-' || "Ma don" AS order_id,
  CAST("Thời gian" AS DATE) AS order_date,
  CAST("Giờ" AS TIMESTAMP) AS order_ts,
  NULL AS product_code,
  NULL AS product_group,
  "Hàng bán" AS product_name,
  "SL bán" AS qty,
  "dvt" AS unit,
  "Amount" AS amount,
  NULL AS customer_id,
  CASE
    WHEN "Khách hàng (tên)" IS NULL
      OR lower(trim("Khách hàng (tên)")) IN ('khách lẻ', 'kl', 'lẻ', 'vãng lai', '')
    THEN NULL
    ELSE "Khách hàng (tên)"
  END AS customer_name,
  NULL AS staff,
  NULL AS channel,
  NULL AS payment,
  "_huy" OR "_don_huy" OR "Trạng thái xử lý" IN ('Huỷ đơn', 'Không giao được') AS is_cancelled,
  "_tra" OR "_don_tra" OR "SL bán" < 0 OR "Trạng thái xử lý" IN ('hàng trả về', 'Đổi trả', 'trả lại', 'Đã trả hàng') AS is_returned,
  'item' AS line_kind
FROM "sobanhang_all"
